description: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — turn these images into a short video with transitions and background music — and get image-based videos back in 30-60 seconds. Upload JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC files up to 200MB, and the AI handles AI video creation automatically. Ideal for marketers, social media creators who want to create videos from photos without manual editing.
